name: Cymru

attributes.attribute: a term in the Welsh language
gives the name of the land of Wales
the people of Wales in their own tongue
brethren or friends in the native speech

sources: Monaghan, Patricia. The Encyclopedia of Celtic Mythology and Folklore. Checkmark Books, 2008.

okr.objective: Cymru is the Welsh-language name of the land of Wales.
key_results: Cymru names the land of Wales in its own language.
The word means brethren or friends.
The tongue, Cymric, remains in everyday use.
okr.evidence: Monaghan, Encyclopedia of Celtic Mythology and Folklore
